root_cause: Production security advisor findings were fixed provider-side before the exact production migration versions were present in GitHub, and the first Trust posture scanner over-classified review surfaces as high-risk. The first source-close replay also assumed every production-only helper/view already existed in a clean preview baseline.

prevention.migration_parity: Every provider-side security DDL must be source-closed using the exact production migration version and name.
prevention.preview_replay: Hardening migrations must be object-existence-aware: harden an object when present, skip it when absent, and never fabricate a production-only helper or view just to make preview replay pass.
prevention.exposure_semantics: Only browser-reachable SECURITY DEFINER views/materialized views are high-risk by default; privileged RPC execute surfaces require authorization review rather than automatic vulnerability classification.
prevention.fail_closed: Provider advisor ERROR/WARN findings stay visible until provider readback is clean.
